title: Flask/Vue selected-filter refresh handoff
task_summary: Keep one cross-layer regression cohesive and preserve its production transport boundary.

approved_outcomes.outcome: All/Read/Unread selection remains active after add, update, and delete refreshes.
Mutation refreshes use the selected filter through the production client transport and Flask route.
The visible active choice, table results, and empty state match the refreshed response.
Existing CRUD success, response shape, and unfiltered behavior remain compatible.

coherent_deliverables.title: Fix selected-filter refresh behavior
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Frontend state, transport, server request, rendering, and regression evidence must all land before the bug is fixed.

acceptable_alternatives: Add, update, and delete may be grouped as variants of one refresh outcome.
fragmentation_examples: Frontend, backend, component-test, API-test, integration-test, and documentation subtasks would split one inseparable bug fix.
important_crossings: Vue selection and mutation refresh use the production transport and Flask HTTP route before rendering results.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve the selected-state owner, refresh call paths, compatibility constraints, and real crossing.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve the observed regression, source pointers, state owner, and public response constraints without the proposed shared fetch-path solution.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent reconstructs one cohesive cross-layer fix and groups CRUD refresh variants.

required_content.content: Where the selected All/Read/Unread filter lives and how it survives add, update, and delete refreshes.
The path a mutation refresh takes through the production client transport and the Flask route.
How the visible active choice, the table results, and the empty state stay consistent with the refreshed response.
What stays untouched: CRUD success behavior, response shape, and unfiltered behavior.
